properties.description: At an epoch or release, answers "what didn't we achieve that we were supposed to?" — every scheduled item returned as delivered, deferred (and where to), discontinued, or OUTSTANDING (still due here, not delivered, and nobody has said which of the previous two it is — the question to put to the user rather than default). Work scheduled after the baseline comes back separately, because a delta measured only against the plan cannot see the work that was not in it. `required` claims that did not land are reported as computed violations rather than slips — the scheduling face of a KPP. The baseline is the target's FIRST snapshot with every later one as the movement trail, so a total slip stays visible across repeated replans; where no snapshot exists the plan never moved and the live edges are the baseline. NOTHING IS STORED: the plan lives in the snapshots and delivery is computed from the golden thread, so writing the outcome down would create a second source of truth able to disagree with the first (`dec:arrival-delta`, `req:completion-computed`).
properties.name: What was planned against what arrived, computed and never stored
